# paper_towel_stand — realism QA repair

Thin weighted disc and narrow vertical spindle; round base and small top cap.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f2320, f2484, f2306. Mean silhouette IoU 0.7992. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/paper_towel_stand_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/paper_towel_stand/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=C, proportions=B, colour_texture=C, articulation=A, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Assigned rubber-base friction rather than a universal coefficient.
- Preserved thin base and spindle colliders and sparse observed placement states.

## Remaining

- Product mass, ballast and rubber-foot construction are not identified.
- Held/repositioned intervals are sparse states, not a continuous trajectory.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.
